shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log --oneline -5 && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && printf '\\n--- test commands ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && printf '\\n--- spec ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.test.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/types/ai.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/shared/logger.ts && sed -n '1,120p' jest.config.js"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npm ls ajv --depth=0 2>/dev/null || true; rg -n '\"ajv\"' package-lock.json | head"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md package.json | sed -n '1,320p'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "test(tools): reject missing required input" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
